scope: Damian: every FSOT quantity should have a physical representation. (1) trace theta_S and the MeV-read leaves (audit/trace_2026-10-02k.tsv, diagnostics); (2) derive f_pi, g_A, g_piNN (and an absolute light-quark mass) by physically motivated relations from FSOT m_pi, m_N and the round-j FSOT Lambda_QCD, no new fitted constants, validated first; (3) downstream only through the gates below; (4) m_s/m_ud gap and the cosmology-pin consistency are diagnostics in the trace (no replacement candidates are frozen, so nothing there can be scored).
trace_findings_fixed_before_scoring: theta_S has no established physical counterpart; the pion/kaon/D/W/Z/H/binding leaves are pure numbers read in MeV (r_p in fm, T_CMB in K, H0 in km/s/Mpc, dm2 in eV^2), unlike m_e, m_mu, m_tau, m_p, m_n which follow the m_e anchor; tying a MeV-read leaf to the anchor needs the SI factor 1e6 e/(h nu_Cs) (e is a defined number) or a physical scale; no AEB2AD pin equals any tested ratio to 1 ppm; the pion leaf was built against the PDG MeV number (hub git history). Consequence for branches: FSOT m_pi is used at its numeric MeV value, which is physically the PDG mass, so it adds no FSOT information beyond the match itself.
